records.text: Candace Owens accuses Erika Kirk of misrepresenting charity work in China and says she was actually there following her then-boyfriend Josh Harrellson, who was a basketball player.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Helping victims of sex trafficking know the truth is that Erika (Erika Kirk) was just following her boyfriend. I kind of view this as her groupie year. ... Her boyfriend at the time is Josh Harrellson. Josh Harrellson is playing for the Miami Heat. OK, so you got a basketball player who was in his prime and he is dating the Arizona beauty queen.

verification.notes: Current records confirm Erika was dating basketball player Josh Harrellson and that he played for Chongqing in China from May through July 2013; Erika's own audition clip says she lived in Chongqing. No reliable source establishes that following him was her sole purpose or that she performed no charity work in China, so the accusation and motive remain unproven.

appearances.snippet: But she very clearly says she lived in China and the answer is she was obviously there longer because she was there from June all the way through until at least August, early August. ... verification.notes: Public basketball records place Josh Harrellson in Chongqing from late May through July 2013. No reliable travel records establish Erika's asserted June-through-early-August stay, so the claimed exact date match cannot be verified.
